design: Paired repair-only comparison of old-current and new guides on identical previously generated candidate seeds, using one common runtime. Not fresh generation, not a first-pass skill-effect test.

comparisons.reason: Both repair supported explanation and speaker-note issues while preserving eight pages, native tables and model data. A provides stronger local qualification on pages1/3 and an explicit page4 fast-path explanation; B disambiguates example mode from Git file mode, names fixed off/on in the page4 title, preserves more callout space there, and more consistently removes stage-bound notes prose. These are complementary benefits without a decisive overall advantage. A crowds page4 callout padding; B tightens page1 card-top spacing. No clipping/overlap identified at reviewed sizes. All seed tables were already visibly clear, so neither earns a table-clearance repair gain. This supports a scoped tie, not equivalence at presentation distance or a stable/causal Skill conclusion.

Cumulative artifact inspection favors A: it repairs the central page-5 weakened-versus-residual false-dichotomy risk with two links and an explicit both-can-have-residue statement, and provides fuller beginner definitions on pages 2–3 without an observed layout regression. B usefully adds usually/manufacturer specificity on pages 1/6 and clearer path compensation on page 7, but leaves the page-5 ambiguity. Both retain safe native tables and scientific boundaries. This is a bounded qualitative preference for these observed artifacts, not an aesthetic numeric score or stable/causal Skill superiority; pages 1,5,7 were observed only in scaled-history composites.

Modest preference for the observed A artifact, not causal Skill superiority. Both repair slide6 table/takeaway collision, preserve substantive conditions/native data and improve slide7 ratio wording. A additionally makes slide3's partial-northern-hemisphere scope explicit on the slide, resolving a concrete globe/grid correspondence ambiguity without clipping. B's slide7 denominator is more explicit than A's pronoun, but both ratios are clear. A's neutral research wording is a polish choice; B's research-provenance/PDF caveats are not treated as stale delivery failures. All seven pages now have actual visible evidence, with mixed-resolution coverage explicitly limited below.

Artifact-level tie with different strengths, not a missing-evidence default. All eight BEFORE/A/B pages now have actual visual observations at explicitly declared scales. Both repair the two tables and preserve native roles, values and conditions. B better communicates skill choice on page1, retains the Chinese base-comparison bridge on page5 and has a less wrapped page6 table. A better separates this deck's production checkpoint from topic explanation on page8 and notes3/8, and gives page5's different-record qualification greater prominence. Neither dominates these substantive outcomes; no aesthetic composite or binary-count ranking is used. This is not a full-resolution/reader-effect/process conclusion.

limitations: Repair-only comparison: both conditions start from the same first-round candidate seed; not fresh generation or an untouched first-pass success test.
One author submission per case/condition. All authors invoked the host pptx skill. Resolved model, token cost and generation time unavailable.
Author-stage image access was incompletely confirmed and overstated claims were corrected in image-access-clarifications.json. The intended full-process comparison was not verified.

Final independent reviewers recovered page coverage with single-image turns. Some pages were observed only in uniformly scaled initial composites; pixel-exact derivative coverage is listed in each pair review. Human presentation-distance readability is unverified.

Initial GDI composite DPI scaling was detected by pixel comparison. Corrected composites preserve all 90 panels exactly; initial scaled evidence and failed attempts are retained, not silently replaced.
Common runtime reliability gains belong to both conditions, not to the candidate guide alone.

Binary grades are evaluator-written diagnostic checks, including post-inspection refinements. They are not a preregistered aesthetic score or causal improvement metric; no aggregate ranking is computed.
Representative programmatic edit persistence is not manual editing usability, automatic chart refresh or human comprehension.
Procedural shared-filesystem isolation and hashes are not a sandbox or a complete author tool audit.

outputs.previous_output: Common before seed for each label, not a separate author run.
